title: CarbonLEI verification verdict
description: Output of `carbonlei verify --json` and of `verdictFor` in sdk/verdict.ts (format 2). Exit codes: 0 VALID, 1 INVALID, 2 CONTESTED, 3 error (the error object below), 4 INCOMPLETE. Check 8 is advisory: a warning does not change `overall`. Check 9 (precursors) and `precursors` appear only for a proof whose credential commits to a precursor statement or that carries precursor evidence.

id.description: Check number (sdk/verify.ts): 0 structure, 1 SAID, 2 disclosures, 3 signature, 4 on-chain report, 5 shipment, 6 KEL anchor, 7 authority chain, 8 reconciliation (advisory), 9 precursors (only for a proof with a precursor part; its PRECURSOR_WARNING codes are advisory).

code.description: Failure or warning code, for example DISCLOSURE_TAMPERED; empty on pass.

overall.description: INCOMPLETE: no check failed and nothing is CONTESTED, but check 6 or 7 did not pass or fail (not run without an evidence checker, or only a warning from a caller's own checker), or the credential commits to a precursor statement that check 9 did not decide; not a pass. CONTESTED also when check 9 found a precursor credential CONTESTED.

primaryCode.description: Code of the first failing check; empty when no check failed.

rejected.description: Disclosures presented but rejected by check 2.

disclosed.description: Field values that matched the signed credential.

chain.description: The chain and the block every on-chain read was pinned to; null when the run stopped before reading the chain (a malformed proof).

checkedAt.description: UNIX seconds used for checks 4 and 5: the shipment's claim time when check 5 bound the shipment to the given EORI, otherwise the block time.

warnings.description: How the checks were run, when the caller should know. SHIPMENT_NOT_BOUND: the proof has a shipment but no EORI was given, so check 5 was skipped and check 4 used the block time, not the claim time. EVIDENCE_NOT_CHECKED: check 6 or 7 did not pass or fail (not run, or only a warning from a caller's own checker); overall is then INCOMPLETE, unless a check failed (INVALID) or check 4 is CONTESTED (CONTESTED). PRECURSORS_NOT_CHECKED: the credential commits to a precursor statement, but check 9 was not run or not decided (the statement or a producer's proof not presented, or a producer's proof INCOMPLETE); overall is then INCOMPLETE unless a check failed or something is CONTESTED.

trustAnchor.description: Root of trust AID check 7 was run with: the demo root unless --trust-anchor was given; null when the caller supplied its own checkers.

precursors.description: Check 9 breakdown (sdk/precursor.ts PrecursorReport): SEE of the good = attributedDirect + the sum of massPerTonne × SEE of each precursor (Commission Guidance No. 3, section 4.2.2.3), compared with the declared value within `tolerance`, all in tCO2e per tonne of good.

signed.description: The statement's digest is in the good's signed credential core (precursorDigest); false: shown for information only, check 9 is then advisory.

verification.description: The producer's proof verification (checks 0–9), with check 5 bound to the good's supplier LEI.

error.description: Why the verification could not run (RPC failure, unreadable proof, bad option). Exit code 3.
